supporting_observations.claim: Sixteen failed domain logons for svc-docsync were recorded on FILE-MAP-01 from 13:37:28 through 13:52:28 UTC. They recur at roughly one-minute intervals and report bad-password status 0xc000006a.

The failures identify FILE-MAP-01 as the workstation and source address 10.53.20.20, with the same LSASS process ID 0x1414 in the records. This is consistent with the inventory description of svc-docsync re-authenticating on its once-per-minute FILE-MAP-01 job.

The repeated bad-password failures are consistent with the provided change-calendar context: svc-docsync's password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC, and the DocSync job requires a manual update afterward. The timing and cadence favor a stale job credential over malicious password guessing.
Domain-controller records corroborate repeated authentication failures for svc-docsync from FILE-MAP-01, including bad-password status 0xc000006a.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy log collection was unavailable from 13:25 to 14:00 UTC, so proxy telemetry for part of the review window is missing.
The supplied authentication records show failures but do not establish whether the DocSync job's credential was subsequently updated or whether later authentication succeeded.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the exact time the svc-docsync password was rotated or when the DocSync job was manually updated.
The 4648 event does not establish whether the explicit-credential use succeeded.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: at 13:59 UTC, a SYSTEM-context Veeam.Backup.Service.exe process on DC-MAP-01 used explicit credentials for svc-docsync targeting PROXY-MAP-01. This differs from the described DocSync job activity; the record alone does not establish success or maliciousness. Investigate separately, noting the proxy-collection outage during this period. Record: T162-00035.
